reason: The two TRANS_B proposals rank first because the supplied mapping is verified and this path skips generated B-stack packing, though its timed A transpose and added A packing may erase that benefit. They are aliases with the same mapping and conversion, so Astra should treat them as one experiment. The 320-byte scratch stride and four-tile store order preserve the reduction and have bounded source changes, but their cache and locality benefits are unverified. The remaining descriptor proposals add timed full-matrix conversions; packed-B adds another conversion, while TA and TT add two. Transpose fusion has unresolved instruction and K-order risks. The general-fallback fused transpose does not target the timed n=512 path. No proposal has measured evidence of a speedup.
